items.title: Jim Cramer Says GameStop’s Turnaround Plan “Actually Works.” Should You Buy?
items.summary: GameStop shut thousands of stores, and its profits keep climbing while sales shrink. Cramer points to collectibles and a giant eBay stake, but one piece of his case carries a risk that could undercut everything else.

items.title: Needham Says GameStop Is More Than a Meme Stock Now—and Sees 20% Upside
items.summary: GameStop (GME) stock has received a new Buy rating from Needham. The firm sees more value in the retailer’s shift toward collectibles and trading cards. It started coverage with a $33 price target, implying about 20% upside from current levels. items.title: GameStop Stock (GME) Has 4 Reasons to Rally Beyond Its Meme-Stock Fame
items.summary: GameStop (GME), Wall Street’s most famous meme stock, is giving investors more reasons to take its fundamentals seriously. The stock has gained more than 30% in 2026, and it’s not just speculation. The retailer saw its operating profit jump 141% last quarter, even as sales fell nearly 19%. items.title: Amazon Is Reportedly Paying $7.5 Billion for Decart’s AI Chip Software
items.summary: Nvidia's grip on AI rests on software, and Amazon just bought a team that built tools for Nvidia's own hardware. The price barely dents Amazon's budget, but one December event could prove whether the bet was smart or just expensive.

items.title: An Umbrella Girl Hummel Sold for $800 in 2000. Auction Houses Now Get About $100, and the Kids Who Inherit the Collection Get No Tax Break for the Drop
items.summary: A lifetime of curio cabinet treasures is about to land on her children's doorstep, and the tax code treats the lost value as if it never existed. One quirk in the inheritance rules may soften the blow in an unexpected way.
